cls.name: MaterialCategory
cls.description: A class of material the network moves. Sole-source risk is a property of a category, not of a plant, which is why it needs to be its own class.

relations_in.name: carriesCategory
relations_in.description: A material flow carries one material category.

relations_in.name: produces
